name: Alexander Hughes
role: Burleigh County Republican elected to the territorial Council, 1886
bio: Capt. Alexander Hughes of Burleigh County was nominated for the Council at the October 1886 legislative convention in Bismarck, which the paper complained had ignored the west-Missouri country. He was reported among the successful candidates in November 1886, with a Republican majority of 1,000 to 1,500.
